drafts.title: DRV8833 single brushed DC motor, qualified5V USB supply
drafts.summary: TI DRV8833PWPR HTSSOP16+EP, bridgeA to2-pin JST PH motor connector. 0.51ohm sense resistor gives~392mA nominal chopping at25C; 205mAtyp/505mApeak is a declared supply reservation, not a hard limit or unknown-motor stall guarantee. Unreviewed; no motor, thermal, regeneration or native layout proof.

datasheet.note: TI SLVSAR1E. HTSSOP PWP pin numbering; one bridge used, second bridge inputs and BISEN grounded, outputs unconnected. PowerPAD must be grounded. VCP10nF X7R>=16V toVM, VINT2.2uF>=6.3V toGND, VM>=10uF ceramic. Actual motor, supply transients and heatsinking require qualification.
Actual catalog-bound C1589/CL10B103KB8NNNC; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

valueWhy.note: VCP toVM, actual50V X7R10nF. This is a charge-pump capacitor, not a VCP-toGND bypass.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C23630/CL10A225KO8NNNC; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

valueWhy.note: VINT internal-bias bypass only: actual16V2.2uF X5R. VINT is not an external rated rail; its graph pin is a passive bypass terminal, not an invented power source. Effective capacitance remains to be verified.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C162430/GRM21BZ71C106KE15L; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C134850/OCR470M1CBK-0605; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component. Polarized polymer capacitor: importer symbol plus mark is on physical pad1; verify assembled polarity and manufacturer dimensional fit.

valueWhy.note: Author-selected47uF16V polarized polymer bulk in addition to2x10uF16V X7R ceramic. Catalog lists1.65A@100kHz ripple; manufacturer PDF unavailable in this capture. Bulk sizing, ESR/ripple, inrush and regenerative braking must be qualified on actual motor/supply. No transient guarantee.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C25819/0603WAF4702T5E; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

valueWhy.note: TI recommends20–75kOhm nSLEEP pullup toVM; actual47k1% is fixed enabled. Internal500k pulldown; inputs00 defaultcoast. No software sleep port.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C34068/1206W4F510LT5E; retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

valueWhy.note: Actual0.51ohm1%250mW1206 sense resistor. VTRIP160–240mV at25C =>310.62–475.34mA nominal-tolerance chopping;392.16mA typical. 3.75us blanking and800ppm/C TCR mean this is not a hard500mA limit. At500mA, resistor dissipation<=0.1288W atnominal25C tolerance, before thermal derating.

datasheet.note: Actual catalog-bound C160352/B2B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN); retained immutable importer/supplier receipts identify the component.

params.why: Board-level4.75–5.25V source must guarantee1.5A under totalboardload; not arbitrary USB2 host permission. VM isUSB VBUS, never3.3VLDO. Motor must be explicitly qualified within the205/505mA reserved envelope.
No actual external motor is selected. Startup/stallcurrent, windingL/R, duty/braking and regeneration remain unqualified;205mAtyp/505peak authorbudget is not motor measurement or hard current limit.

citation.note: Manufacturer minimum10uF ceramic; author2x10uF16V X7R chosen for nominal margin. 6.1mm origin-distance screen is an author policy, not a manufacturer placement limit. Verify effective DC-biased capacitance, actual pad distances and short high-current loops natively.
Fixed nSLEEP pullup47k within TI20–75k recommendation; always enabled afterwake delay. No MCU5V connection.

firmware.usage: MCU must drive IN1/IN2 using output-capable pins; speedPWM additionally requires actual PWM capability (RP2040 agreed GP14/15). Port schema has no PWM-requirement field, so plan review must check MCU facts. Set both pinsLOW before enabling OUTPUT, wait>=1ms afterVM valid (2ms authorpolicy). 00coast,10forward,01reverse,11brake; fast-decay speedPWM appliesPWM toonepin whileotherLOW. Use targetcore analogWrite/digitalWrite, no extra library. Startspeed0, clampduty, coast before reversing; software is not stall/current/temperature protection. Fixedsleep47k is alwaysenabled, no shutdownGPIO. Never ground either motor terminal or route motor current through3.3VLDO. Qualify motor/supply startup, stall, USBinrush, EMI, regeneration/braking, effectivecaps andthermalbehavior; no hardware-fit/manufacturing claim.
